headline: Metro 1.5.0 is live: date links (?date=…&station=…) with a copy-link button, a dated correction log in English and Czech led by the Line D start-date error, and the two Line D source links under the Line D text. The growth line is unchanged.

shipped.title: Metro 1.5.0: Pavol's picks of 1 Nov (date links, correction log, Line D sources)
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-01 at 390 px on https://metro.dravec.org: ?date=1988-10-26&station=dejvicka shows October 1988, 33 stations, 3 lines, detail 'Leninova'; Copy link put https://metro.dravec.org/?date=1988-10-26&station=dejvicka on the clipboard; ?date=2026-02-30&station=nope opens on November 2026 with no station; Corrections and Opravy each have 4 entries, the first being the Line D start (1 March 2022 → 21 April 2022); Line D source links (archiweb.cz ČTK, ČT24) present in EN and CS; scrollWidth 390; sitemap lastmod 2026-11-01; BUILD_DATE 2026-11-01.

decisions.question: Correction log: same page or a /corrections/ section?
options: Same page, after the Line D text (EN) and in the Czech section
Separate /corrections/ route
decisions.default_taken: Same page: 'Corrections' (#corrections) and 'Opravy' (#corrections-cs), the same entries in both, held equal by a test.
decisions.why: The smaller change: no new route, sitemap entry or build config.

decisions.question: Which entries, and in what order, so the case-2 date error comes first?
options: Oldest first, starting with the 27 Oct round
Newest first (the 28 Oct Line A fix would lead)
Oldest first including the 17 Oct fixes (those would lead)
decisions.default_taken: Oldest first from 27 Oct: Line D start (1 Mar → 21 Apr 2022), Line D stations and order, Line D opening (late this decade → second half of 2032), Line A 1978 text (7 new → 6 new; Můstek an interchange from 1985). A note under the list points to the changelog for the 17 Oct fixes (line B order, Strašnická and Skalka dates).
decisions.why: Puts the case-2 error first as picked, and still discloses the earlier fixes. Backfilling the 17 Oct entries is a few lines if wanted.

decisions.question: Sources for the correction entries
options: Wikipedia line articles (re-checked 1 Nov)
DPP pages only
decisions.default_taken: Line D start: the ČTK report (same link as the map). Line D stations and 2032: Wikipedia, Line D (Prague Metro). Line A 1978: Wikipedia, Line A (Prague Metro). All re-checked today.
decisions.why: The DPP 18 Sep 2026 release does not state 2032, and no DPP page states the station list in one place; Wikipedia does and agrees with the data.

decisions.question: What counts as an invalid or out-of-range date link?
options: Real calendar day from 9 May 1974 to the later of the viewer's today and the build date
Up to the viewer's today only
Up to the slider's end (2029)
decisions.default_taken: First option. Bad days such as 2026-02-30, malformed values and dates outside the range open on today, with no error and nothing shown to the reader.
decisions.why: A link copied in Prague just after midnight can be dated a day ahead of a viewer west of UTC; the build date covers that. Future dates have nothing new to show.

decisions.question: Which station values are valid, and what about mixed cases?
options: Only stations the map draws; a valid station with a bad date opens today with the station
Drop both when either is bad
decisions.default_taken: Only drawn stations (unknown ids and Line D stations without a construction start are ignored). A valid station with a bad date opens on today with that station. A station not yet open on the linked date is still selected; its detail gives the opening date.
decisions.why: Keeps as much of the reader's intent as is valid, quietly.

decisions.question: Should the URL bar follow the map as you move?
options: No; links come from the Copy link button
Rewrite the URL on every move (replaceState)
decisions.why: Not in the pick; Copy link covers sharing. Easy to add later.

decisions.question: Copy link when the browser has no clipboard
options: Show the link in a selectable text box
Fail silently
decisions.default_taken: Selectable text box (one, reused on further taps); 'Copied' otherwise.
decisions.why: The reader still gets the link.

decisions.question: link_opened: when does it fire, with what props?
options: Once per load, only when the URL has date or station: {date shown, station or null, fallback}
Only for fully valid links
decisions.default_taken: First option, dispatched at DOMContentLoaded so the analytics module is listening; the station is selected at the same moment so its line_d_detail is not lost.
decisions.why: fallback=true shows how many shared links are broken; no new event names.

decisions.question: Independent review findings
options: Merge as is
Fix them first
decisions.default_taken: Fresh subagent (diff + goal only) found nothing blocking. Fixed all five minor findings before merge: changelog order, stacked fallback boxes, 'Copied' wiped during Play, line_d_detail lost on Line D links, build-day links west of Prague. Also fixed its notes on Object.hasOwn (older Safari) and the llms.txt station-id wording.
decisions.why: Each was small and covered by a new test.

proposals.name: Backfill the correction log with the 17 Oct fixes
options: Add line B order, Strašnická/Skalka dates and the 1985 Line B event as dated entries (Wikipedia Line A/B, re-checked 1 Nov)
Keep the changelog pointer
proposals.recommendation: Backfill, at the end, dated 17 Oct, with the log reordered newest first so the 27 Oct entries stay on top. That needs Pavol's OK because it changes 'first entry'.

proposals.name: Count copied links
options: key_action link_copied {date, station}
Rely on link_opened and referrers only
proposals.recommendation: Add it: it shows whether anyone shares, separate from whether links get opened. One line, existing taxonomy.

proposals.name: Portfolio record refresh
options: Update flywheel/data/products/metro.json to 1.5.0 from the hub
Leave until the next sweep
proposals.recommendation: Update it from the hub; this session's GitHub scope is Chartres/metro only.
